notes: Reviewed 2026-11-15: carbon-limited chemostat samples are nutrient_limited_growth; they stay the study baseline | Four unmodified strains (MG1655, commensal IAI1, environmental TW11588 clade IV, TW09308 clade V) in chemostat, batch and starvation (chemostat medium flow stopped 4 h). All strains treated as reference genotype (no engineered changes); chemostat and batch samples are controls, starvation samples are carbon_starvation. Batch growth_phase left out: 'collected when reaching steady-state' is no phase word. Starvation samples: culture_mode and phase left out (stopped chemostat vessel, neither true chemostat nor flask batch). Oxygen only for shaken batch cultures; chemostat aeration not described.
